visual_brief: Lakhta Center is a solitary, tapering blue-glass tower whose twisting facets converge into a sharp needle, with low angular glass wings at its base. Its setting is the waterfront in northwestern St. Petersburg; classic views look across the bay or along the beach and show the full tower above the low complex. Distinguish it from Moscow's clustered towers, the smoother Lotte World Tower, and proposed Lakhta sister-tower renderings.
notes: Seven candidates retained. Recommended: c6, then c1 and c4. Original-size JPEGs decoded and visually inspected; no watermarks or added text overlays found. Licence strings reproduce source-page labels, which link to the Pexels terms: https://www.pexels.com/license/. References were viewed only, never copied or downloaded. Downloads used Node after curl TLS failed and Python was unavailable. The ancillary repository follow-up check could not run because its configured Python interpreter is missing.
